title: Figures 6-7: Silicone foam-cuff tracheostomy tube and silicone scar-repair sheets
description: Product photograph labeled "FOAM-CUFF-TRACHESTOMY TUBE" showing a clear tube with green foam cuff and red valve, captioned "Figure 6. Silicone Tracheostomy Tube". Below, two photos show a Mepiform silicone sheet and a woman's face with the sheet applied to the cheek, captioned "Figure 7. Silicone Sheets Used Under the Skin as a Physical Supporting Layer for Repair of Scar Tissue".
